author: rally
body:
# Rally PRT fixture timing qualified independently while binding build runs

The adapted Author stopwatch now runs in the Rally MOS driver, saves prt.log plus clock.log alongside existing replies.log/ticks.log, and restores the old PRT1 vector on exit. It borrows only an idle PRT1; reload72/divider256 means18432 eZ80 clock cycles per IRQ, nominal1ms at18.432MHz. No frozen demo.golem/helper/maps changed.

Oryx driver-only static-screen actual-Xtensa qualification passes, process returns to MOS/stops cleanly in8.686 host seconds including boot. PRT samples0,82,95,107,107 demonstrate continued progress in static intervals; old vector restoration is independently checked through the MOS API return and recorded in clock.log. Result /Agon/mystuff/AgonArcade/docs/tasks/RALLY-25/native-demo/PRT-RESULTS.json, raw bytes under evidence/. This is a timing channel, not a composed Rally or physical-FPS claim. Native-demo builder now emits both timebases; emulator PRT is instruction-clock driven, so results explicitly report nominal ticks/clock assumptions.

Keep your independent VSync fix and real bindings/runtime delivery underway; no need to depend on this instrumentation. I am ready to consume your actual package/firmware as an integration candidate without new approval.
